facts.business: JK Agri Genetics Limited is engaged in the production, processing, and sale of hybrid seeds including cotton, paddy, maize, bajra, wheat, and vegetables, along with export of seeds to international markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company plans to commercially introduce jowar and maize in Burkina Faso under the ECOWAS region to expand registration footprint across West African countries.
guidance_or_targets.value: Commercial introduction of jowar and maize

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company has introduced a new mustard crop in Nepal, currently under its second season of registration, with commercial launch expected shortly.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on overdue trade receivables of Rs. 1,823.61 lakhs and security deposit of Rs. 121.68 lakhs from Rajasthan State Seeds Corporation (RSSC), where legal action has been initiated. The arbitration petition was adjudged against the Company on grounds of limitation. The Company has filed Objection Application before High Court of Rajasthan challenging the orders. As per legal opinion, management considers the amount good and recoverable, no provision considered necessary.

key_risks: Significant supply of illegal glyphosate-resistant Bt cotton seeds adversely impacting farmer demand for approved BG cotton seeds
Delayed monsoon conditions in northern Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and western Uttar Pradesh affecting demand for long-duration bajra hybrids
Maize prices declining below Minimum Support Price (MSP) due to reduced demand from ethanol sector
Geopolitical challenges in export markets such as Bangladesh, Sudan, Nepal, and West Asian war preventing sorghum export to Egypt
Government-subsidised seed distribution in key wheat growing states impacting demand for certified wheat seeds
Overdue trade receivables of Rs. 1,823.61 lakhs and security deposit of Rs. 121.68 lakhs from RSSC under legal dispute
facts.related_party_note: Bengal & Assam Company Ltd. holds 31,32,860 shares (67.56%) as promoter. Deposit against legal cases of Rs. 121.68 lacs included in Other Financial Assets (Refer Note no.47.2c (ii)).
